name: Platform and hiring-algorithm audits
payer: Platform or employer pays the auditor.
access: DSA: access to data and premises; LL144: employer-supplied data.
publication: DSA audit reports published in redacted form; LL144 summaries public.
ai_analogue: The nearest cousin: AI-system audits with statutory independence rules written at the start (no non-audit services in the prior year, rotation) rather than after a scandal.

milestones.trigger_criterion: Undisclosed data use affecting tens of millions of users

milestones.event: NYC Local Law 144 requires bias audits of automated employment decision tools (effective 2023).
DSA Article 40 grants vetted researchers data access to very large platforms.
EU Digital Services Act Article 37 requires annual independent audits of very large platforms.
DSA delegated regulation on audits: auditor independence, limits on prior non-audit services, rotation.
Published analysis of 116 LL144 bias audits finds shallow and inconsistent audits.
milestones.trigger_criterion: Published audits found shallow and inconsistent

status: seed; secondary sources, years spot-checked; verify against a primary source before citing in the paper

mechanisms.note: Platform pays and selects under independence constraints; Commission receives full reports.
